## OnePlus Nord N100 (`oneplus-billie2`)

From [devices/oneplus-billie2/features.yaml](../devices/oneplus-billie2/features.yaml), updated 2026-11-20.

| Feature | Status | Notes | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| RAM boot (fastboot boot) dev loop | works | fastboot boot of make-ramboot.sh images, with netroot or the installed root (fap.root=); needs a fresh ABL session per attempt | [README.md](../boot/android-bootimg/README.md) |
| Boot from internal storage | works | ABL normal-boots boot_a with dtbo_a erased; plain ext4 root on userdata (not bootc yet) | `2c68e81` |
| USB networking / serial (gadget) | works | serial + NCM network (172.16.42.1); on normal boot since qcom,select-utmi-as-pipe-clk (image v3) | `02fa6df` |
| CPU frequency scaling | works | qcom-cpufreq-hw, 0.3-1.8 GHz | `e50bb83` |
| Thermal zones and cooling | partial | 16 zones read; CPU zones have no cooling maps, so only the 110 C critical trip acts | [hidden-dependencies.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/hidden-dependencies.md) |
| Suspend (s2idle) | untested | s2idle not tried; plan needs MPM / system sleep state (docs/hardware/n100-power-and-install.md A2) | [n100-power-and-install.md](../docs/hardware/n100-power-and-install.md) |
| Reboot to bootloader from Linux | broken | `reboot bootloader` doesn't reach fastboot; needs the PON reboot-mode for bootloader | [TODO.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/TODO.md) |
| Crash logs (ramoops/pstore) | untested | ramoops in the mainline DT, pstore mounts; no crash captured yet to prove it | `e50bb83` |
| Display panel | works | MSM DRM + our generated ILI9882N panel driver, 720x1600 60 Hz; no LCDB driver (no panel power-off), 90 Hz not exposed | [README.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/kmod/panel-ili9882n/README.md) |
| Backlight | works | DCS backlight, 0-2047 | `8505e57` |
| GPU acceleration | partial | Adreno 610 (freedreno) with the phone's zap shader and DDR votes; UBWC off (FD_MESA_DEBUG=noubwc) or tiles corrupt | `02fa6df` |
| Hardware video decode/encode | broken | Venus not enabled in the DT; firmware on modem_a | [n100-gpu-video-display.md](../docs/hardware/n100-gpu-video-display.md) |
| Buttons (power, volume) | works | power, volume up/down via PMIC nodes in our DT (evtest) | `343b854` |
| Touchscreen | works | our ili9882n-ts SPI driver as DRM panel follower; firmware from the phone; suspend/resume untested | [README.md](../kmod/ili9882n-ts/README.md) |
| Wi-Fi | partial | ath10k WCN3990 via the modem (RAM-only rmtfs); startup needs retries, random MAC per boot, generic board data | [hidden-dependencies.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/hidden-dependencies.md) |
| Bluetooth | broken | WCN3988 on UART SE3 (hci_qca) not in the DT yet | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| USB host / OTG | broken | PMI632 Type-C + VBUS not in the DT yet (DT-only work) | [n100-charging-usb.md](../docs/hardware/n100-charging-usb.md) |
| Hotspot / USB tethering | untested | Wi-Fi works; NetworkManager hotspot not tried |  |
| NFC | untested | README lists NXP nq-nci, TODO says probably not fitted: verify | [README.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/README.md) |
| Loudspeaker | broken | no sound card yet (ADSP + LPASS + WCD937x); AW87529 amp can damage the speaker: follow the plan | [n100-audio.md](../docs/hardware/n100-audio.md) |
| Earpiece | broken | no sound card yet; AW87359 amp | [n100-audio.md](../docs/hardware/n100-audio.md) |
| Headphone jack / USB-C audio | broken | no sound card yet | [n100-audio.md](../docs/hardware/n100-audio.md) |
| Microphones | broken | no sound card yet; a PipeWire null sink keeps apps from crashing | `74bc5ce` |
| Battery level | partial | voltage-based estimate from the vendor OCV table (kmod/adc-ocv-battery), read-only | [README.md](../kmod/adc-ocv-battery/README.md) |
| Charging and charge status | partial | status guessed from USB input voltage; Linux doesn't drive the PMI632 charger (never bind qcom_smbx: 4.87 V) | [n100-charging-usb.md](../docs/hardware/n100-charging-usb.md) |
| Fast charging | broken | no charger control | [n100-charging-usb.md](../docs/hardware/n100-charging-usb.md) |
| Vibrator / haptics | works | PMI632 vibrator (image v3), tested at 31 %; keep strength <= ~73 %; Plasma haptics not checked | `02fa6df` |
| Accelerometer / gyroscope (rotation) | broken | sensors sit behind the ADSP (libssc + hexagonrpcd); ADSP not enabled yet | [n100-sensors-misc.md](../docs/hardware/n100-sensors-misc.md) |
| Proximity sensor | broken | on the ADSP, see accelerometer | [n100-sensors-misc.md](../docs/hardware/n100-sensors-misc.md) |
| Ambient light sensor | broken | on the ADSP, see accelerometer | [n100-sensors-misc.md](../docs/hardware/n100-sensors-misc.md) |
| Magnetometer | broken | on the ADSP, see accelerometer | [n100-sensors-misc.md](../docs/hardware/n100-sensors-misc.md) |
| Fingerprint reader | broken | Egis ET520 on a TrustZone-owned SPI bus: likely not feasible | [n100-sensors-misc.md](../docs/hardware/n100-sensors-misc.md) |
| microSD card | untested | SDHCI controller probes; no card tried | `e50bb83` |
| Notification LED | n-a | probably not fitted (verify) | [TODO.md](../devices/oneplus-billie2/TODO.md) |
| Rear camera | broken | CAMSS/CCI nodes for SM6115 missing; OV13B10 needs a DT match patch | [n100-cameras.md](../docs/hardware/n100-cameras.md) |
| Front camera | broken | CAMSS/CCI nodes missing; OV8856 driver exists | [n100-cameras.md](../docs/hardware/n100-cameras.md) |
| Camera flash / torch | broken | PMI632 flash not in leds-qcom-flash | [n100-cameras.md](../docs/hardware/n100-cameras.md) |
| Modem firmware boots | partial | MPSS boots from modem_a with RAM-only EFS (fap-modem-ram); early start can stall, retried | `409bb00` |
| SIM detection | untested | no SIM yet; ModemManager over QMI not tried | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| SMS | untested | no SIM yet | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| Mobile data | broken | needs the IPA v4.2 node (from agatti) and rmnet | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| Voice calls (incl. call audio) | broken | call audio needs q6voice and a sound card | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| GNSS / GPS | untested | QMI LOC + geoclue not tried | [n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md](../docs/hardware/n100-telephony-bt-gnss.md) |
| Mobile desktop (Plasma Mobile / Phosh) | works | Fedora 45 + Plasma Mobile from userdata (installroot), autologin; shown with the old @kde-mobile-environment root, the explicit-list rebuild (decision 0003) not booted yet | `2c68e81` |
| Android apps (Waydroid) | works | Android 13 on Rust binder, GPU via freedreno with noubwc; no audio; ~1 min first start | [waydroid.md](../docs/waydroid.md) |
| Image updates (bootc upgrade/rollback) | broken | installed root is a plain ext4 tarball; bootc/ostree + fap-android-boot not done | [README.md](../boot/android-bootimg/README.md) |
